reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration that connects Tencent Weixin bots through QR-code authorization, relays supported messages using the iLink Bot API, and maintains per-account Harness sessions.

summaries.zh: 通过二维码授权将腾讯微信机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，接收支持的微信消息并将 Harness 回复发回微信。
summaries.en: Connects Tencent Weixin bots to DeepSeek Harness through QR-code authorization and relays supported messages and Harness responses.

capabilities: Connects Tencent Weixin accounts through QR-code authorization
Stores bot credentials through the Harness credential service
Receives Weixin messages via long polling and sends Harness responses back to Weixin
Maintains per-account sessions, cursors, and message deduplication state
